categories.actuallyUsed: Layer is registered, initialized, AND called in at least one pipeline endpoint (/api/v1/analyze, /api/v1/orchestrate/analyze, or /api/v1/orchestrate/intelligent)

criticalFindings.title: 11 Advanced Engineering Layers exist but are NEVER called in any pipeline
criticalFindings.detail: These 11 layers represent ~5,000+ lines of code. They are properly initialized, have full API routes, but are never invoked by /api/v1/orchestrate/intelligent or any other pipeline endpoint. They only work if a client calls their dedicated routes directly. The orchestrate/intelligent endpoint only calls 5 layers: SemanticValidator, ConfidenceEngine, CrossModelValidator, BOQAuditor, DigitalTwin.
criticalFindings.fix: FIXED: All 11 layers are now called in /api/v1/orchestrate/intelligent in 11 ordered phases.

criticalFindings.title: 2 Layers had standalone routes only (not in any pipeline)
criticalFindings.detail: These were initialized and had routes but were never called as part of the main analysis pipeline.
criticalFindings.fix: FIXED: VisionNavBridge.synchronizeProject() and BenchmarkExtension stats are now included in orchestrate/intelligent.

criticalFindings.title: Knowledge Base data is hardcoded, not loaded from external sources
criticalFindings.detail: packages/construction-knowledge/ contains JSON templates but zero populated CSV data. packages/ai-engine/knowledge-engine/ files (knowledge-graph.js, standard-quantities.js, productivity-rates.js) have hardcoded data.
criticalFindings.fix: Phase 2 of the Engineering Foundation Program: populate CSV files, build data loading pipeline, replace hardcoded data.

criticalFindings.title: Training Data Bridge loads empty CSV files
criticalFindings.detail: packages/databases/training/csv/ files exist with headers only — no real training data. TrainingDataBridge.loadAll() finds 0 records across all sources.
criticalFindings.fix: Populate training CSV files with real project data from historical records or synthetic generation.
